integrity: The proof iterates the published lifting theorem from the published four-general-points seed. At each step the evaluation-map hypothesis is verified from the exact regularity of the projected zero-dimensional complete intersection. Closed-form cardinalities and degree comparisons are independently checked by the packaged verifier; the verifier does not replace the geometric lifting theorem.
scientific_limitations: The construction answers only the 'in particular' clause of Question 5.2. It does not prove optimality among all Artin--Schreier configurations or all geproci sets, and it uses the sufficient surjectivity criterion from the initiating lifting theorem.
title: Iterating the four-point seed gives smaller Artin--Schreier geproci families
